comparison.objective: Align and lock a suction tool onto a robot quick-change flange; candidate performs manual screen separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Tight dowel/bushing alignment, face seating while supporting a tool, and locking-ring actuation versus bimanual screen grasping, agitation and support replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Correct tool seated and ring turned ≥25°, wrong tool never locked, hands clear and arms home versus recovered media mass, retained washers and supported screen dwell.
comparison.reason: This is precision mechanical coupling and lock actuation, whereas the candidate tests many-body selective separation; their bimanual hold-while-operating pattern is too generic for overlap.
